tests.name: CM-S1-U: through BOTH legacy saveConnectionRpc and v2 mutation dispatch, attempt a save against (1) malformed JSON, (2) invalid registry shape, (3) injected non-ENOENT EACCES/EPERM/EIO read failures. Snapshot exact registry bytes and all fake keychain values first; assert byte/value equality after rejection, zero secret-staging calls, zero writer/rename calls and a non-empty sanitized registry-unreadable error rather than []/success. Include a replacement-password draft to prove extraction cannot occur before the failed read. ENOENT is a separate valid-unmanaged-empty control, never conflated with these failures.
